description.value: You convince others to do their own research using specifically curated data and misinformation you casually guide them into finding on the infosphere. The first time you fail to Lie to the target (but not critically fail), you convince them that you were given faulty information, the data isn't all in yet, or you were both mislead, and the target doesn't gain a circumstance bonus against your further attempts to Lie to them. If you're a master in Deception, you can fail to Lie twice in the same conversation before they begin to suspect you, or four times if you're legendary in Deception.
